ip_address.label: Raumfeld host
ip_address.description: IP address of the device running the Raumfeld host service (a physical Raumfeld device or the Raumfeld app acting as host). Filled in automatically when the host is found on the network.

port.label: Raumfeld host port
port.description: Port of the Raumfeld host webservice. Only change this if you run the host on a non-default port.

restart_on_join.label: Restart playback when a room joins
restart_on_join.description: A room added to a group that is already playing can play slightly behind the others. With this on, playback starts again where it is when a room joins, so every room is in sync, at the cost of a short pause. Switch it on for the room that plays behind, or for the room that leads the group.

manifest.description: Stream music to Teufel Raumfeld (Smart Speaker) multiroom devices.

errors.no_host_found: No Raumfeld host found at the given address. Check the IP address and port, and make sure a Raumfeld device or the Raumfeld host app is running.
